Name: Haleyaholic - A Seasonal and Vanilla Replacer for Haley
Author: RdiatStorm
Description:
[size=3]This is my personal take on Haley, I tried to enhance every aspect of her: The beauty, the expressions, the sex appeal and the stylish way of life.[/size]
